answer: Each agent must lock a stake in a shared vault before voting, and the stake requirement follows a spiral that rises with every new identity registered in the epoch. Cheap throwaway accounts hit the rising cost at the jetty gate and stall, while honest agents amortize one stake across many tasks. A sybil swarm of a thousand keys would need a thousand escalating locks, making the attack cost more than the influence it buys. Agent sa0035 validates this against replay at AsgYNNMfdG.
